description: Search research grants and funding awards in the Dimensions database. Returns grant information including funding amounts, funders, and research organizations. funderOrgName must match an exact Dimensions funder name (acronyms like NCI and NSF are resolved automatically). Umbrella labels such as NIH often match no grants — discover institute names with facet_query or aggregate_query on facetField funder_orgs.

confirmLargeFetch.description: Required when skip≥5000, page≥5, or limit=1000 with skip>0. Acknowledges Dimensions reasonable-use policy (dimensions://schema/policy).

fields.description: Fields to return. Accepts aliases or DSL names. id is always included; publications also always include doi. Use dimensions://fields/{entity} for the full list.

filters.description: Additional where-clause filters. Each item needs field, operator, and (except for is_empty/is_not_empty) value, e.g. {"field": "researchers.id", "operator": "=", "value": "ur.01343614074.49"}. Supported operators: =, !=, >, <, >=, <=, in, is_empty, is_not_empty.

funderOrgName.description: Filter by funder organization name. Acronyms NCI, NSF, NEH resolve automatically; use facet_query/aggregate_query on funder_orgs to discover exact names.

page.description: Page index (0-based). Equivalent to skip = page × limit. Max page 49.

query.description: Free-text search terms. Optional — omit for a filters-only search that relies solely on `filters` and/or the entity-specific convenience filters (e.g. yearFrom/yearTo).

skip.description: Records to skip (0-based). Mutually exclusive with page. Max window: 50000 total records.

sortBy.description: Sort results by this field (funding_amount_usd = funding_usd, funding_amount_eur = funding_eur)

startYearFrom.description: Filter grants starting from this year (inclusive)

startYearTo.description: Filter grants starting up to this year (inclusive)

name: search_grants

largeResultWarning.description: Soft warning when totalCount exceeds 10,000 — narrow filters first

pagination.description: Pagination metadata when results span multiple pages

policyNotice.description: Reasonable-use reminder when results are truncated or very large

truncated.description: True when more results exist beyond this page

title: Search grants
